When this rule applies, read and follow `securevibe/skills/secure-supply-chain-infra/SKILL.md` (and the reference files it links to) before writing code.

Scope: Secure dependencies, builds, containers, CI/CD and cloud config. Use when adding or upgrading packages (npm, pip, cargo, go, maven, gems, composer), writing package.json/requirements/pyproject/lockfiles, Dockerfiles or compose files, GitHub Actions/GitLab CI workflows, Terraform/OpenTofu/CloudFormation/Pulumi, Kubernetes/Helm manifests, nginx configs, or deployment scripts. Prevents hallucinated/typosquatted packages (slopsquatting), unpinned versions and actions, CI script injection, leaked build secrets, root containers, public buckets, and over-privileged IAM.
